comparison.objective: Arrange cartons into stable stacks satisfying a height-to-base rule; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Box orientation, stacking, and bimanual handoff versus small-tool engagement and fine force-controlled adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: All cartons correctly stacked with no stack exceeding three times its base; no complete indexed spec or full geometric rubric.
comparison.reason: Tests stability-aware packing, not commissioning or dynamic response.
